culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Chiharu Shirakawa. Chiharu points out that Misuzu had always referred to as "Chiharu-san," yet her brother and sister were only referred to by name. Chiharu felt distant from the family for having been a daughter from her father's first marriage and not being related to Misuzu by blood. She had admired Misuzu as an actress and always tried to please her, but despite everything she did, it was never enough. The last straw was when she overheard the victim planning to take her out of the will.

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are watching the ending of an old movie staring retired actress Misuzu Shirakawa at her home. As the trio tour the home with the actress, her three children, and the maid, they are surprised to witness consistent quarreling in the household with Misuzu Shirakawa being the unpleasant one. As the afternoon draws close, the actress retires to her bedroom for an afternoon nap. Soon after, a car accident occurs outside, and then smoke emerges from the bedroom.

suspects: Kyousuke Shirakawa, Chiharu Shirakawa, and Saori Shirakawa
